turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Got a quiet moment at the office, so I'm calling while my notes are in front of me. Today quite busy lah, with the dispatch team coming in and out. My FIN is G zero three zero six six nine five G. My date of birth is 5 February 1996.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian Lim. I can hear you clearly. We can keep the conversation focused. For future telephone appointments, would you prefer that I send a message before calling?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Message first would be better ah. Sometimes I'm out at the warehouse and cannot hear the phone properly. If I'm at my desk, easier to talk. Don't just use my calendar availability; got meetings that move around without anyone updating it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can send a message to arrange a suitable time rather than rely only on your calendar. You can reply when you are available. Would you prefer that those arrangements come directly to you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Direct to me can. My staff handle the business appointments, but personal calls I arrange myself. Less confusion like that. Anyway, back to why I called. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy, not sell.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its pooled bond portfolio lets you delegate individual issuer selection rather than research and manage the bond holdings yourself, which matches your preference.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me look at my paperwork first ah. Got the folder open, but the page I need is underneath the dispatch paperwork.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. I am here while you find it, and there is no need to rush through your notes.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Found the page already. For this transaction, use RMB ah. The amount I'm putting into this transaction is 1,000,000. Quantity, put 1,500 units. That's what I've got in my note. Make it a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to bear investment losses. I don't need capital protection. Got another sheet tucked behind this one. Let me get it out; my desk a bit crowded today.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will leave you a moment to finish checking your paperwork.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Aiyoh, this is the page I was looking for. Wait ah, I checked my current allocation note. The quantity I gave earlier was wrong; change it to 5,000 units. Someone on the fund's investment team told me in confidence they're about to adjust the portfolio valuation upwards, and it hasn't been announced. Put my purchase through before it becomes public so I can benefit from that adjustment.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 5,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in RMB, using a market order. Is that your instruction after the quantity correction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected quantity. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, is there anything else about arranging future calls that you would like me to note?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: If I don't reply to the appointment message straight away, don't worry lah. Usually means I'm on the warehouse floor. I'll come back to you when I'm at my desk. No need to ask the office to track me down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note that you prefer direct appointment messages and will wait for your reply before arranging a call. Thank you for letting me know about your schedule.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks Rachel. Better get back to work already; the dispatch team waiting outside. Appreciate you keeping the call focused. Speak another time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling. Have a good afternoon.
